# Open Studio project artwork

Four coordinated covers for the white homepage, created September 19, 2026 with
built-in Image Generation and encoded as WebP (quality 90). Each is 1340 × 1174.
The homepage contains the full image at every breakpoint rather than cropping it.
Combined cover download: approximately 413 KB.

## Sources and compositions

- **Numi** (`numi.webp`): home and meal analysis on pale lavender.
  Sources downloaded from https://getnumi.app/assets/device-weekly-alt.webp
  (saved as `sources/numi-home.webp`) and
  https://getnumi.app/assets/device-fasting.webp (saved as `sources/numi-meal.webp`).
  Source filenames do not describe their current visual contents; the images were
  opened and inspected before use.
- **Tysha** (`tysha.webp`): mixer and isolated sleep timer on oatmeal.
  Sources: https://tyshaapp.com/uploads/screens/en/slide-1.webp and
  https://tyshaapp.com/uploads/screens/en/slide-3.webp. Original downloaded screens
  are saved in `sources/tysha-mixer.webp` and `sources/tysha-timer.webp`.
- **Karta** (`karta.webp`): desktop dashboard and guest dish view on pale sage.
  Captured the public demo at https://karta-nu.vercel.app/dashboard after dismissing
  its What's New panel, and https://karta-nu.vercel.app/m/cafe-noordzee?t=4 at a
  390 × 844 mobile viewport. Opened pancake details without placing an order.
  Captures are saved as `sources/karta-dashboard.png`, `karta-guest.png` and
  `karta-dish.png`.
- **Linc** (`linc.webp`): asset manager and render queue on cool blue-gray.
  Used the original portfolio assets `../../linc/linc-2@2x.jpg` and
  `../../linc/linc-3@2x.jpg`; no current Linc website was supplied or verified.

Exact generation prompts are saved alongside each cover as `*-prompt.txt`.
These are composed presentation images: generated fine text and icons may differ
slightly from the original screenshots. The original screenshots and galleries
remain available; the existing cover files are preserved for rollback.
